test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Direction: In the following sentence, an idiom is highlighted. Select the alternative which best describes its use in the sentence.

“Just add a bit of cheese to your pasta and __Bob’s your uncle!__” Reena suggested it to me over dinner last night.

options.text: It becomes easily and quickly achievable

solution:
The correct answer is: **It becomes easily and quickly achievable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**Bob’s your uncle!**" is used enviously for someone who achieved something in a simple manner without having to work hard for it.

 
 
• Example - *You add two cups of water to the mix, heat it for five minutes and Bob’s your uncle__, the soup is ready.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Bob’s your uncle!**" is "**It becomes easily and quickly achievable**"(आसानी से और शीघ्रता से प्राप्त करने योग्य)
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
